content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICAR CRRI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Master degree in Remote Sensing and GIS / Geoinformatics / any discipline of Agriculture with 4 years / 5 years of Bachelor's degree. OR B.Sc (Ag) having four (04) years graduation degree followed by M.Sc. in any discipline. OR Post-graduate degree in Environmental Science / Geography with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years masters' degree should have NET qualification and two (02) years of research experience in the relevant field. OR Ph.D. in any discipline of science.

content_sections.text: Written-cum-Personal Interview Screening Test (if large number of candidates)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the ICAR CRRI SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 11th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Master's degree in relevant fields like Remote Sensing and GIS, Geoinformatics, Agriculture, Environmental Science, or Geography, with specific Bachelor's degree requirements and NET qualification or Ph.D. as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this ICAR CRRI recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI SRF recruitment going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the ICAR CRRI office in Cuttack, Odisha (Pin Code: 753006).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written-cum-Personal Interview. A screening test may be conducted if there is a large number of candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at ICAR Central Rice Research Institute Cuttack.
